scale contiguous attention transfer length after logical blocks expand to physical blocks

historical_observations.qwen35: The reference PR reports that the pre-existing Mooncake path could not initialize a hybrid full-attention plus GDN layout.
historical_observations.deepseek_v4_flash: The reference PR discussion records standalone GSM8K accuracy of about 0.9507 and pre-existing 1P1D Mooncake accuracy of about 0.0485.

base.failure_boundary: The mixed-layout worker reaches the real Mooncake worker constructor and fails when the GDN backend is treated as an ordinary attention cache. Scheduler cases also retain the wrong cache-only GDN prompt boundary.

verifier_contract.collection_integrity: JUnit contains exactly 18 unique, passing, non-skipped cases for full reward.
behaviors: mixed full-attention and GDN workers initialize through the existing connector interface
full-attention, MLA, sliding-window MLA, and GDN payloads reach their matching destination blocks
null state placeholders are ignored and unrequested bytes remain unchanged
padded and shared-storage views stay within valid registered memory
logical-to-physical block ratios greater than one do not overlap or corrupt neighboring blocks
registration, transfer, group-count, and producer-consumer layout failures are not reported as successful
cache-only GDN remote prefill and decode preserve the final-token recomputation boundary for token IDs and prompt embeddings
cold and fully cached warm requests remain schedulable and the prefill engine remains healthy
pure full-attention Mooncake transfer and NIXL remote-prefill behavior remain compatible

e2e_boundary.path: hybrid KV configuration and P/D request metadata -> real Mooncake worker construction and registration -> real metadata encoding/decoding, group-aware transfer planning, and producer send lifecycle -> pointer-based copy into consumer CPU tensors and completion status
e2e_boundary.scheduler_composition: Separate behavior cases enter through the real Scheduler.add_request, Scheduler.schedule, and Scheduler.update_from_output lifecycle for cold, warm-prefix, token-ID, and prompt-embedding requests.
e2e_boundary.substitution: Deterministic CPU tensors replace model forward passes. An in-memory engine replaces native Mooncake RDMA and validates registered ranges before performing the exact pointer-based copies requested by production connector code. A loopback socket replaces ZMQ transport while retaining production message encoding and response handling.
e2e_boundary.preserved_semantics: Cache group cardinality and order, logical and physical block identities, byte strides and payloads, null placeholders, registration ranges, failure codes, request ordering, and cold/warm lifecycle state are preserved.
e2e_boundary.limitations: The verifier does not execute GPU kernels, model weights, native Mooncake RDMA/NVLink, multi-node transport, or full-model accuracy evaluation. It does not claim coverage for Mamba variants other than GDN.

independent_challenge.case: An unpublished ratio-three MLA plus GDN transfer with non-contiguous logical blocks.
